name: Parcel-held delivery-fee scam (SingPost impersonation)
source: Synthetic case built from the blueprint's Section 8 test plan (Track 03, scam-defence demo).

payload.text: SINGPOST: Your parcel is HELD at our depot due to an unpaid delivery fee of $1.99. Settle within 24 hours or it will be returned: https://bit.ly/parcel-hold-9x2 - enter your IC number S1234567D, card details 4111 1111 1111 1111 and the OTP we sent. Urgent! Call +65 9123 4567 immediately.

expected.flow_note: Router fires both Module 1 (urgency + credential + payment signals) and Module 2 (contains_url) concurrently; Module 2 exposes the bit.ly shortener; synthesis returns HIGH with quoted cues; a 'report' decision produces the redacted Module 3 bundle.

notes: NRIC/card/phone values are fake but format-valid so the redactor must catch them. The shortened link must never be auto-opened in a real browser; Module 2 traces it server-side only.
